meta.description: Implement tasks from an OpenSpec change. Use when the user wants to start implementing, continue implementation, or work through tasks.

copy.tagline: 逐项完成规格变更中的开发任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有一个OpenSpec变更清单,正要动手实现其中的开发任务。
copy.tagline_en: Complete development tasks from a spec change
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an OpenSpec change and want to start implementing its tasks.

howto.what: 该技能让 Claude 根据 OpenSpec 变更清单逐项实现任务：先选定或询问变更、查看状态和指令、读取相关文件，然后循环实现每个未完成任务并勾选，全部完成或遇阻时显示进度并暂停。
howto.when: 当你想开始实现、继续实现或处理 OpenSpec 变更中的任务时触发。

say.note: Claude选取变更并开始执行任务

say.text: 继续实现未完成的任务
帮我处理openspec变更里的任务
say.note: Claude会确认变更后逐步实现

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude implement tasks from an OpenSpec change step by step: it picks the change, reads status/instructions/context files, then works through pending tasks, checking them off, and pauses with progress if stuck or done.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to start implementing, continue implementation, or work through tasks in an OpenSpec change.

say_en.note: Claude selects the change and starts.
Resumes from where it left off.

say_en.text: Help me work through the tasks in the openspec change.
